entries.name: ranges
entries.type:
∀ (prefixFuel : Nat) (recorded : List Nat) (winner : Nat)
      (moved : EnumerationWaitingIndex.Waiting) (joined : EnumerationState.State Symbol EnumGuard),
      ExceptT.run (SourcePruningEnumerationTerminalPrefix.run prefixFuel first rest waiting before) =
        [.ok ((recorded, winner, moved), joined)] →
      SourcePruningEnumerationFold.Ranges checkEmpty recorded beforeCaller joined winner memos.query ∧
      ∀ (foldFuel P H : Nat) (foldCaller : Caller width)
        (folded : EnumerationState.State Symbol EnumGuard) (foldQueries : Queries),
        SourcePruningEnumerationFold.run checkEmpty foldFuel P H recorded beforeCaller joined winner memos.query =
          (.ok (some [.ok ((), folded)]), foldCaller, foldQueries, folded) →
        match folded.values[winner]? with
        | some (.unenumerated (some oldHandle) _) =>
            match lookupNode foldCaller.checked.native.machine.heap oldHandle with
            | some old => SourceCurrentAllocatedNativeRequestBounds.WordRanges
                (.code (SourceRecursiveIntersectionCode.requestNode IntersectionEmptyDomain.emptyDomain incoming old))
                foldCaller.checked
            | none => True
        | _ => True

entries.name: same
entries.type:
EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.replace («Symbol» := Symbol) roots
      (.unenumerated oldNode oldScs) (.unenumerated newNode (incomingScs ++ oldScs)) waiting =
      EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.count roots 1 incomingScs waiting

entries.type: ∀ extra P H, foldP ≤ P → foldH ≤ H → SourcePruningEnumerationFold.run checkEmpty (foldFuel + extra) P H recorded beforeCaller joined winner memos.query = (.ok (some foldRaw), foldCaller, foldQueries, folded)

entries.name: foldCompleted
entries.type: foldRaw = [.ok ((), folded)] → (∃ (node : Option Nat) (scs : List EnumerationState.Suspended), folded.values[winner]? = some (.unenumerated node scs)) ∧ ∀ source ∈ recorded, source ≠ winner → folded.values[source]? = some .eliminated

entries.name: foldRejection
entries.type:
foldRaw = [] →
        ∃ («prefix» : List Nat) (source : Nat) (suffix : List Nat)
          (prefixCaller : Caller width) (prefixEnum : EnumerationState.State Symbol EnumGuard)
          (prefixQueries : Queries) (action : EnumerateM Symbol EnumGuard Unit),
          recorded = «prefix» ++ source :: suffix ∧
          (∀ extra P H, foldP ≤ P → foldH ≤ H →
            SourcePruningEnumerationFold.run checkEmpty (foldFuel + extra) P H «prefix» beforeCaller joined winner memos.query =
              (.ok (some [.ok ((), prefixEnum)]), prefixCaller, prefixQueries, prefixEnum)) ∧
          (∀ extra P H, foldP ≤ P → foldH ≤ H →
            SourcePruningEnumerationDispatch.dispatch checkEmpty (foldFuel + extra) P H
              prefixCaller prefixEnum source winner prefixQueries =
                (.ok (some action), foldCaller, foldQueries)) ∧
          ExceptT.run (action prefixEnum) = [] ∧ folded = prefixEnum
entries.reason: Imported fold frame/rejection detail is not needed by this Terminal conclusion.

entries.name: foldCounts
entries.type: EnumerationCanonicalWaiting.Correct (EnumerationCanonicalUnion.mergedRoots roots recorded winner) folded.values moved

entries.name: reading
entries.type: ∀ extra, ExceptT.run (getValue (incomingR + extra) winner folded) = [.ok (.unenumerated oldNode oldScs, read)]

entries.name: incomingRun
entries.type: ∀ extra extraNative P H, incomingP ≤ P → incomingH ≤ H → SourcePruningEnumerationIncomingNode.run checkEmpty (incomingR + extra) (incomingN + extraNative) P H foldCaller folded winner incoming incomingScs foldFinal.query = (.ok (some (if replacement = .empty then [] else [.ok ((), afterWrite)])), afterCaller, savedQueries, read)

entries.name: writePrefix
entries.type:
ExceptT.run ((do
  setValue winner (.unenumerated (some handle) (incomingScs ++ oldScs))
  inheritAncestry winner) read) = [.ok ((), afterWrite)]

entries.name: afterSame
entries.type: afterWrite = {read with values := read.values.set winner (.unenumerated (some handle) (incomingScs ++ oldScs)), recursionAncestry := fun other => if other = winner then (read.expansionAncestry ++ read.recursionAncestry winner).eraseDups else read.recursionAncestry other}

entries.name: incomingPost
entries.type: Post formulas solver next foldCaller afterCaller final

entries.name: unfolding
entries.reason: The public Terminal packet retains Post and query identity but does not separately repeat unfolding extension.

entries.name: optional
entries.type: oldNode = none → replacement = incoming ∧ afterCaller = foldCaller ∧ savedQueries = foldFinal.query ∧ final = foldFinal ∧ next = foldInventory

entries.name: present
entries.type: ∀ oldHandle, oldNode = some oldHandle → ∃ (old query : Node) (queried : SourceEqualityNativeDemand.State width), lookupNode foldCaller.checked.native.machine.heap oldHandle = some old ∧ next.source = foldCaller.checked.native.machine.heap ∧ next.roots = foldInventory.roots ++ [incoming, old] ∧ SourceCurrentAllocatedTargetQuery.Receipt formulas solver next incoming old foldCaller.checked query queried foldFinal ∧ (∀ ambient term, InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient replacement term ↔ InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient incoming term ∧ InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient old term) ∧ (checkEmpty = false → replacement = query ∧ afterCaller = SourceCurrentAllocatedPartialState.advance foldCaller queried foldCaller.fourth foldCaller.merge ∧ final = foldFinal)

entries.name: lookup
entries.type: UnionFind.findRoot incomingR folded.representatives winner = some found

entries.name: readSame
entries.reason: Read counts/stored slot use the retained actual frame.values; this equivalent endpoint equation is redundant.

entries.name: receipt
entries.type: SourceCurrentAllocatedTargetQuery.Receipt formulas solver next incoming old foldCaller.checked query queried foldFinal

entries.name: meaning
entries.type: ∀ ambient term, InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient replacement term ↔ InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient incoming term ∧ InternedGuardedLanguage.meaning (SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver) ambient old term

entries.name: disabled
entries.type: checkEmpty = false → replacement = query ∧ afterCaller = SourceCurrentAllocatedPartialState.advance foldCaller queried foldCaller.fourth foldCaller.merge ∧ final = foldFinal
entries.reason: Terminal retains the SAME actual receipt/meaning but does not repeat the imported flag-false subpacket.
